tolerance_justification: BLOCKED, not green. catboost.model_based_eval() is implemented in process over the same core entry point the CLI mode drives (ModelBasedEval, catboost/libs/train_lib/train_model.h:147), but the mode is GPU-only: the CPU trainer refuses it (train_model.cpp:942) and PlainJsonToOptions only maps its options when task_type is GPU (plain_options_helper.cpp:394). No CUDA device is available to this project (design spec 9.1), and the pinned CLI oracle itself dies with 'CUDA error 35: CUDA driver version is insufficient' on this host, so no numbers exist on either side to compare. The declared CLI tolerance (relative 1e-9, spec 4.3, never bit-exact) stands but is unexercised. Per spec 4.4 a skipped test never counts as green, so this row stays red. tests/testthat/test_model_based_eval.R covers everything reachable without CUDA (option pipeline, dataset load, feature-name/range resolution, ignored-feature guards, and the specific GPU-requested-but-unavailable error). See docs/phase-4/P4.8-report.md.
final_method_note: CLI mode continues a baseline model's training in short experiments with and without each tested feature set and writes per-experiment error logs into train_dir, so elementwise numeric comparison is the right method. Confidence raised from 55 after inspecting mode_model_based_eval.cpp and running the pinned binary: the mode is GPU-only, which is why the row cannot be verified here.
